style.desc: e-ink-inspired desktop; warm grayscale, very sharp black lines, large serif content, monochrome outlined controls and visible focus patterns

arrange.text: The document sits on the left and the form sits on the right.

description: Copy the values from a document on the page into a web form. "document-to-form lite". The page shows a source document and a web form; the agent copies the values from the document into the form, leaves fields blank when the document does not contain them, and finishes
sample: Please use form formats for values supplied by the receipt; fields without source data stay empty.
identity: A source document sits beside a web form where values from the document are entered into labeled fields.
screen: An invoice or till receipt shows a header and line items beside a form with several fields for document details and amounts. Text fields start empty, a few choices can have defaults, and dropdown lists are closed.
never: A portrait on the source document
hint: Provide a readable invoice/receipt with Invoice number INV-1042, Date 2026-09-12, Vendor Polar Freight, Total 148.50 USD. Matching empty fields plus optional PO number absent from source; leave it blank.
